chapter_seo_title: Chapter 578: Burying the Bones of the Fallen – War Ancestor Arises
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen becomes a War Ancestor after years of grief. He scatters the remains of his fallen friends across the Nine Provinces and joins Keke's father to battle Otherworld Ancestral Gods.
